findings.text: Companies House holds no insolvency record for the company.
Accounts are not overdue; the next accounts are due 26 August 2027, and the last accounts were made up to 28 February 2026.
The confirmation statement is not overdue; it was last made up to 18 June 2026 and the next is due 2 July 2027.
The register records 2 outstanding and 7 satisfied charges, 9 in total, with none part-satisfied.
There are 11 current officers, comprising 10 directors and 1 other officer.
No current person with significant control is on record, although this does not prove the company has no owner, as it may be exempt or have filed a PSC statement not covered by this tool.
Across 5 of the 10 current directors checked, 83 other companies were found, of which 53 are active, 25 dissolved, 4 converted closed and 1 in liquidation.
Since 24 October 2025 no registered office address changes were filed, and one director resignation was recorded: PERSON 037 on 6 May 2026.
